report.explanation: Alert observations show all checkout requests returning 200 with durations 78-344 ms; traces show successful inventory, payment, and order spans with no errors. Metrics show /v1/checkout 200s and zero 502s, though p95 latency is 437 ms. No error, timeout, pool exhaustion, or memory-leak signal is present, and the deployment record alone cannot establish latency causation. Current evidence does not substantiate any bounded root cause.
missing_evidence: Error/exception logs for gateway and downstream services during the incident window
Dependency operation metrics (redis/postgres latency, timeouts, errors) for the gateway
Baseline p95 latency for /v1/checkout to judge whether 437 ms is anomalous
Confirmation of whether the alert indicates a real degradation or is informational
